subject: Medford High School Outdoor Amenities
overview: The Community Preservation Committee recommended funding for the Osgood House restoration and additional contingency funds for the Playstead digital scoreboard. The committee also discussed potential funding and bonding strategies for the Medford High School rebuilding project and reviewed upcoming eligibility forms.

items.title: Osgood House Exterior Restoration
items.summary: Approved a recommendation of $10,000 for the Unitarian Universalist Church to restore the exterior of the historic Osgood House using fiberglass gutters and storm windows.

items.title: Playstead Digital Scoreboard Contingency Funding
items.summary: Approved an additional $32,000 in contingency funding for the digital baseball scoreboard at Playstead Park after construction bids returned higher than expected.

items.title: Medford High School Outdoor Amenities Project Introduction
items.summary: Discussed potential partnership opportunities and long-term bonding options for outdoor recreation and open space elements of the Medford High School reconstruction project. The committee agreed to establish a subcommittee to coordinate a funding strategy.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Reviewed upcoming Eligibility Determination Forms for the new grant cycle, discussed options for an August social gathering, and approved the minutes from the June 9 meeting.
